# Theme Toggle

Icon button that flips data-theme on <html> and persists the choice. Its accessible name says what will happen (“Switch to light theme”). Shows Sun in dark mode, Moon in light mode.

## Import

```tsx
import { getDocumentTheme, setDocumentTheme, ThemeToggle, useDocumentTheme } from "@cesuain/ui";
// or the per-component entry point
import { getDocumentTheme } from "@cesuain/ui/theme-toggle";
```

## API

Exports: `getDocumentTheme`, `setDocumentTheme`, `ThemeToggle`, `useDocumentTheme`.

Types: `Theme`, `ThemeToggleProps`.

Props, defaults and live examples are on the Storybook Docs page, generated from the TypeScript types.

## Figma

Component properties in the Figma library:

## Design tokens

This component sets no token-backed styles of its own; it inherits them from its children.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `theme-toggle.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library. Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
